hero.title: I Build Things That Don't Blend In
hero.subtitle: Designer and developer obsessed with bold interfaces, honest materials, and work that holds up under scrutiny.

paragraphs.0: I started out breaking themes apart just to see how they worked, and never really stopped. A decade later that same curiosity drives every project I touch — strip it down, rebuild it better, make it impossible to ignore.
paragraphs.1: My work lives at the intersection of raw structure and refined detail: thick borders, unapologetic type, and interfaces that feel like they were built on purpose, not assembled from a template.
paragraphs.2: These days I split my time between client work, side projects, and writing about the craft. If it's bold, functional, and a little stubborn, I probably made it.
